ADVENTURE TOGETHER
In F10 → Guild you can create a guild, invite companions and manage the requests received. Invitations must be accepted by the recipient.

The guild master manages roles, members, and tags. The panel shows the companions and the experience of the guild. You can continue your quests even playing alone.

In F10 → Friends you can find requests, friends and players you meet around the world. Friendship is mutual. The block prevents mod requests.

Map sharing is reserved for your guild. You can use it manually or activate it from the related options.

THE WORLD REMEMBER YOUR PROGRESS
The map remains the original Valheim one. You can add placemarks and share exploration with the guild from F10's Map panel.

Gold, quests and social data are separated by world and character. Changing the world can therefore show different progress.

In single player, syncing is handled by your game. In multiplayer, hosts and players must have the same version of MMO MOD. Wait for syncing before using features.

The host can disable economy, quests, wayfarer or village. This guide describes the functions available with default settings.

IL TUO SALDO ORO\nGuadagni oro con comba:
YOUR GOLD BALANCE
You earn gold from combat, skill advancements, and redeemed quests, depending on the host's settings.

In F10 → Economy you can deposit inventory coins into the mod's balance, withdraw them and transfer gold to a known character in the world. «Movements» shows the history.

The shops use the mod's gold balance. You can also deposit coins in the seller window. Each item shows quantity and price before purchasing.

Leave free space in your inventory for purchased items. If the delivery fails, the gold related to the undelivered items is refunded.

SCEGLI LA TUA AVVENTURA\nHai tre mission:
CHOOSE YOUR ADVENTURE
You have three daily and three weekly quests: fight, collect materials, explore new areas or increase skills. Progress is recorded as you play.

Too difficult? Use «Change activity» on a still incomplete daily plan: choose a different and easier objective. You have three total changes per day. The change resets the mission progress and halves the gold reward.

Upon completion, press "Redeem". EXP depends on the action required: 20 per enemy, 2 per resource, 1 per new area, 50 per skill level. Increases the mod's adventurer level, distinct from native abilities.

Daily passes renew at 00:00 UTC; weeklies on Monday. EXP works even without a guild.
